Prospect news

Sites to check by hand for prospect news (links only: the spotter never reads these sites). When someone's getting hot, add them to your risers.

  • MLB Pipeline Top 100: The official ranking prospects.yaml is based on (big update every January, smaller mid-season).
  • FanGraphs: The Board: FanGraphs' prospect rankings with scouting grades; good for spotting risers early.
  • Baseball America prospect rankings: Top 100 and team-by-team lists; some articles need a subscription.
  • Prospects Live: Rankings, draft coverage and minor-league notes.
  • Arizona Fall League stats: October-November: hot Fall League hitters often get a card bump (good riser ideas).
